questions.prompt: Which 1917 event led to the end of czarist rule in Russia?
questions.fact: 1917 brought two revolutions. The first, in February, ended czarist rule; the Bolsheviks took power in the second, in October.

questions.prompt: Which property describes mass per unit volume?
questions.fact: Density is why a steel ship floats: the hull encloses enough air that the whole vessel is less dense than the water it sits in.

questions.prompt: Which sport uses a pit lane during races?
questions.fact: Pit stops are won and lost in seconds — a Formula 1 crew can change all four tyres in under two.

questions.prompt: Which show features a school bus that can shrink and travel inside the body?
questions.fact: Ms Frizzle's catchphrase — take chances, make mistakes, get messy — was the whole teaching philosophy of the show.

questions.prompt: Which line of longitude is defined as zero degrees?
questions.fact: Zero degrees runs through Greenwich because Britain dominated 19th-century sea charts, not for any natural reason.
